description: Critical safety rules to prevent audio damage and ensure professional results

rules.name: Low-End Smear Warning
rules.condition: Applying time manipulation (half-time, stutter) to sub-bass or 808s
rules.warning: Time manipulation destroys transient definition in low frequencies, causing smearing and phase issues

solutions.description: Apply Gross Beat to a duplicate track, blend with dry bass
steps: Apply Gross Beat to duplicate only
High-pass the Gross Beat track at 100-150Hz

solutions.description: Apply Gross Beat to the full mix bus instead of individual bass
steps: Move Gross Beat to mix/master bus
Effect applies to mid/high frequencies only

solutions.description: High-pass before Gross Beat, blend with dry low-end
steps: Add high-pass filter before Gross Beat
Parallel route dry low-end around effect

rules.prevention: Never apply half-time or stutter directly to solo bass/808 tracks
rules.whenToBreakRule: Only for intentional 'degraded' texture effects, clearly labeled as experimental

rules.name: Click and Pop Prevention
rules.condition: Sharp envelope transitions in stutter or gate patterns
rules.warning: Attack times below 5ms often create digital clicks and artifacts

solutions.description: Set minimum 10ms attack for all stutter/gate patterns
Set minimum 15ms release for smooth transitions
Use Gross Beat's built-in smoothing feature

rules.prevention: Always start with Attack: 20ms, Release: 30ms as safe defaults
rules.exception: Intentional 'glitch' aesthetic may use 0-5ms for digital character

rules.name: Tempo Sync Requirement
rules.condition: Gross Beat not tempo-synced to project
rules.warning: Effects will drift from beat, creating sloppy, unprofessional sound

solutions.description: Turn on tempo sync in Gross Beat settings
Snap envelope drawing to beat divisions

rules.prevention: Always verify tempo sync is enabled before programming envelopes
rules.exception: Freehand experimental effects may intentionally be unsynced

rules.name: Commit to Audio Best Practice
rules.condition: Leaving Gross Beat as real-time plugin in final mix
rules.warning: Real-time processing adds CPU load and can cause dropouts during playback/export

commitProcess.description: Render Gross Beat effect to audio file
steps: Solo the track with Gross Beat

rules.alternative: Use FL Studio's 'Freeze' function for temporary CPU relief
rules.prevention: Plan to commit effects once arrangement is finalized

rules.name: Buffer Position Warning
rules.condition: Pos control or envelope extends beyond buffer boundaries
rules.warning: Trying to read audio that hasn't been recorded yet

solutions.description: Set Pos to 0% for real-time playback

rules.prevention: Always start with Pos at 0% unless intentionally using delay effect

safetyChecklist: Mix level is appropriate for context
source: [SRC: IL-MAN] Image-Line Gross Beat documentation and professional mixing best practices
